entries.description: a prior is witness-tier knowledge ABOUT a corpus
entries.subject: a prior

spans.text: The boundary matters: a prior is witness-tier knowledge ABOUT a corpus, not evidence FROM one.

| Axis | Metric | What it captures | |---|---|---| | **Phasepost** | Asymmetric compression (DL) in 27-cell space | *How* content is structured | | **Surprise** | KL divergence from corpus prior | *How expected* content is | | **Entity** | Jaccard overlap on coref surfaces | *Who* content is about |
Cosine is symmetric; compression isn't: - **DL(content | prior)**: "is this content an instance of what the prior knows?"
